questions.question:

Stomach sleepers were rated as being more gregairious and uncomfortable with criticism.
questions.solution: C) The correct spelling of ‘gregairious’ is ‘gregarious’which means “fond of company; sociable” सामाजिक, मिलनसार

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: A)The correct spelling of 'Consciencious' is'Conscientious'which means “wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly” ईमानदार, कर्तव्यपरायण.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: A)The correct spelling of ‘Pronounciation’ is ‘Pronunciation’ which means “the way in which a word is pronounced” उच्चारण

questions.question:

I am in a hurry so I will see you tomorow

questions.solution: B)The correct spelling of ‘Condimnation’ is ‘Condemnation’which means "the expression of very strong disapproval" निंदा.

questions.question:

The ministir ordered the engineers to build roads through high mountains and bridges across deep ravines in a week
questions.solution: A)The correct spelling of ‘Ministir’ is ‘Minister’which means “a high-ranking government official” मंत्री, मंत्रीपदाधिकारी.

questions.question:
Select the option with the correct spelling to replace the underlined word in the given sentence.
A natural clamity causing huge destruction and loss of life and property
questions.solution: D)The correct spelling of ‘clamity’ is ‘calamity’which means “a great and sudden disaster or misfortune” आपदा, विपत्ति

questions.question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.
King Zheng is known to lead an army of a million armoured soldiers, a thousand chariots and ten thousand horses in his misssion to conquer the neighbouring kingdoms
questions.solution: C)The correct spelling of ‘Misssion’ is ‘Mission’which means “an important assignment carried out for political, religious, or commercial purposes” मिशन, अभियान.

questions.question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.
It was a privvilege to receive the award from the President.
questions.solution: D)The correct spelling of ‘privvilege’ is ‘privilege’which means “a special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group” विशेष अधिकार.

questions.question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.
The Chinese are believed to have a longer history than that of any other civilisation in the wolrd
questions.solution: A)The correct spelling of ‘Wolrd’ is ‘World’which means “the earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features” दुनिया, विश्व.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: C)The correct spelling of ‘Definate’ is ‘Definite’which means “clearly stated or decided; not vague or doubtful” स्पष्ट.

questions.question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.
She decided to file a complaint with HR after being harrasad by her supervisor for several weeks
questions.solution: B)The correct spelling of ‘harrasad’ is ‘harassed’ which means “subjected to aggressive pressure or intimidation” उत्पीड़ित, परेशान.

questions.question:

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: C)The correct spelling of ‘Neice’ is ‘Niece’which means “a daughter of one's brother or sister” भतीजी, भांजी.

questions.question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.
There are a number of artists currently creating unique, collectble teapots
questions.solution: A)The incorrectly spelt word in the sentence is "collectble." The correct spelling is "collectible," which means "an item that is worth collecting as it may increase in value over time" संग्रहणीय वस्तु.

questions.question:

He lost all senisation in his legs through a cramp
questions.solution: C)The correct spelling of ‘senisation’ is ‘sensation’which means “a physical feeling or perception resulting from something that happens to or comes into contact with the body” अनुभूति, संवेदना.

questions.question:

To avoid indigetion, it is necessary to chew food properly

questions.solution: D)The incorrect spelling is ‘Conglomirate’. The correct spelling is ‘Conglomerate’, which means “a large corporation formed by the merging of separate and diverse firms” एकत्रित या संयुक्त कंपनी.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word
questions.solution: C)The correct spelling of 'Immidiately' is'Immediately'which means "at once; instantly" तुरंत, त्वरित.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution: B) The correct spelling of ‘Quientessential’ is ‘Quintessential’which means “representing the most perfect or typical example of a quality or class” महत्वपूर्ण, उत्कृष्ट.

questions.question:

questions.question:
